text:
I’m gonna be real here for a sec. I fucking love Rails. Laravel would not exist as we know it without Rails.

After Heroku’s death announcement, we’ve been working on making Laravel Cloud an amazing home for Rails developers and applications. And other developers that believe in care, craft, and the art of software.

We’ve hired Rails experts to help us do this. To help us make it absolutely perfect. 

We’ve got a few more details to sweat before we release it because I want it to be absolutely amazing.

If you’re a Rails developer who still loves Rails and you want to give a talk at Laracon 2027 about something awesome you’re building in the AI era with Rails, DM me.

If you’re a Rails company and you want to talk about the next amazing place to run your Rails application, DM me.
